alice: Yup @bob pinned both model and runtime: `model=open-llama-13b-4bit`, `runtime=rl-infer-1.3.2` in the deploy spec.

carol (eng-release): Add an automatic fallback policy: if p95 latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive samples, halt rollout and fallback to tag v2.4.0. I'll be on standby to trigger rollback if needed. :eyes:
